```{r}
## 1. Open and inspect the EMEP4UK 2024 file

library(terra)
library(ncdf4)
library(rstudioapi)

# Find the folder containing this R Markdown file
rmd_path <- getActiveDocumentContext()$path

if (!nzchar(rmd_path)) {
  stop(
    "Save and open EMEP4UK_SIA_analysis.Rmd before running this code."
  )
}

analysis_dir <- dirname(rmd_path)

# Location of the downloaded NetCDF file
emep_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "raw_data",
  "EMEP4UK_met2024_emis2023.nc"
)

if (!file.exists(emep_file)) {
  stop("EMEP4UK file not found:\n", emep_file)
}

cat(
  "File found:", basename(emep_file),
  "\nFile size:", round(file.info(emep_file)$size / 1e9, 2), "GB\n"
)

# Limit terra's memory use and create a temporary working folder
terra_temp <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "processed_data",
  "terra_temp"
)

dir.create(
  terra_temp,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

terraOptions(
  memfrac = 0.5,
  tempdir = terra_temp,
  progress = 1
)

# Read only the NetCDF header to identify available variables
nc <- nc_open(
  emep_file,
  readunlim = FALSE
)

available_variables <- names(nc$var)

nc_close(nc)
rm(nc)

# Variables relevant to the analysis
variables_needed <- c(
  "SURF_ug_PM25_rh50",  # total PM2.5
  "SURF_ug_SIA",        # secondary inorganic aerosol
  "SURF_ug_NH4_F",      # particulate ammonium
  "SURF_ug_NO3_F",      # fine particulate nitrate
  "SURF_ug_SO4",        # particulate sulfate
  "SURF_ug_PPM25",      # primary PM2.5
  "SURF_ug_NH3",        # gaseous ammonia
  "HMIX",               # mixing-layer height
  "WDEP_PREC"            # precipitation
)

variable_check <- data.frame(
  variable = variables_needed,
  available = variables_needed %in% available_variables
)

print(variable_check, row.names = FALSE)

# Stop if the two essential variables are missing
essential_variables <- c(
  "SURF_ug_PM25_rh50",
  "SURF_ug_SIA"
)

if (!all(essential_variables %in% available_variables)) {
  stop("An essential PM2.5 or SIA variable is missing.")
}

# Open only total PM2.5 and SIA
# The values remain stored in the NetCDF file, not loaded into RAM
pm25_2024 <- rast(
  emep_file,
  subds = "SURF_ug_PM25_rh50"
)

sia_2024 <- rast(
  emep_file,
  subds = "SURF_ug_SIA"
)

# Check the resulting objects
print(pm25_2024)
print(sia_2024)

cat(
  "\nNumber of daily SIA layers:", nlyr(sia_2024),
  "\nSpatial resolution:", paste(res(sia_2024), collapse = " × "),
  "\nValues currently held in RAM:", inMemory(sia_2024),
  "\n"
)

print(range(time(sia_2024)))

# Display the first daily SIA map
plot(
  sia_2024[[1]],
  main = "EMEP4UK secondary inorganic aerosol: first day"
)
```

```{r}
## 2. Select AURN background locations for PM2.5 validation

background_types <- c(
  "Urban Background",
  "Suburban Background",
  "Rural Background"
)

# Import complete AURN metadata
aurn_meta_2024 <- openair::importMeta(
  source = "aurn",
  all = TRUE,
  year = 2024
)

# Standardise column names
names(aurn_meta_2024) <- gsub("\\.", "_", names(aurn_meta_2024))

# Select background locations measuring PM2.5 during 2024
aurn_sites_2024 <- aurn_meta_2024 |>
  dplyr::filter(
    grepl("^PM2\\.5", variable, ignore.case = TRUE),
    site_type %in% background_types,
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(longitude)
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(code, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Convert locations to the EMEP projection
aurn_points_2024 <- terra::vect(
  aurn_sites_2024,
  geom = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "EPSG:4326"
) |>
  terra::project(terra::crs(sia_2024))

cat("Selected AURN locations:", nrow(aurn_sites_2024), "\n")
print(table(aurn_sites_2024$site_type))

# Plot modelled SIA with AURN validation locations
plot(
  sia_2024[[1]],
  main = paste(
    "EMEP4UK modelled SIA with selected",
    "AURN background monitoring locations",
    "1 January 2024",
    sep = "\n"
  ),
  plg = list(title = "SIA (ug/m3)")
)

plot(
  aurn_points_2024,
  add = TRUE,
  pch = 21,
  bg = "#E57200",
  col = "white",
  cex = 0.8
)
```

```{r}
## 3. Extract daily EMEP4UK values at AURN locations

pm25_at_aurn <- terra::extract(
  pm25_2024,
  aurn_points_2024,
  ID = FALSE
)

sia_at_aurn <- terra::extract(
  sia_2024,
  aurn_points_2024,
  ID = FALSE
)

aurn_emep_2024 <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  code = aurn_sites_2024$code,
  date = as.Date(terra::time(pm25_2024))
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    emep_pm25_rh50 = as.vector(t(as.matrix(pm25_at_aurn))),
    emep_sia = as.vector(t(as.matrix(sia_at_aurn))),
    sia_percent_pm25 = dplyr::if_else(
      emep_pm25_rh50 > 0,
      100 * emep_sia / emep_pm25_rh50,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    aurn_sites_2024 |>
      dplyr::select(
        code,
        site,
        site_type,
        latitude,
        longitude
      ),
    by = "code"
  )

saveRDS(
  aurn_emep_2024,
  file.path(
    analysis_dir,
    "processed_data",
    "aurn_emep_2024.rds"
  )
)

cat(
  "Rows:", nrow(aurn_emep_2024),
  "\nSites:", dplyr::n_distinct(aurn_emep_2024$code),
  "\nDates:", paste(range(aurn_emep_2024$date), collapse = " to "),
  "\nMissing PM2.5:", sum(is.na(aurn_emep_2024$emep_pm25_rh50)),
  "\nMissing SIA:", sum(is.na(aurn_emep_2024$emep_sia)),
  "\n"
)
```
